title: I loved the blue and white 'china' style travel mug.
text: I loved the blue and white 'china' style travel mug.. This is a very attractive travel mug but is EXTREMELY HEAVY especially when full of hot coffee. it keeps the coffee nice and hot, almost too hot to drink for an hour or so. This would be great for a long FreeWaY commute, but not a good option for just errands around town. I bought a 'green' refabricated one from Starbucks that says "Sip sensibly" for the errand trips.
